display.purpose: Hero name (Aimee Marcos). Identity layer only — the single largest, most characterful element on the page.

subtitle.purpose: Hero subtitle 'Graphic Designer'. Functional clarification; muted via the Ink Muted color token, not opacity.

section-heading.purpose: Identity-layer headings: 'capabilities', 'strategic strengths'. Not for toolbox or nav.

functional-heading.purpose: Process/tool headings: 'approach + toolbox'. Organizational, not identity.

body.purpose: Hero tagline, primary reading copy. Max line length 68ch.

label.purpose: Nav links, footer credit, contact CTA, mobile nav (16px).

label-micro.purpose: Section marks (01 / work) and marginalia kickers above each work card. Sole uppercase usage in the system.

motion.name: ease-out-expo
motion.purpose: Default easing for all transitions involving movement. Used on card hover scale, hero animation, marginalia clipPath wipe, contact CTA gap shift.

motion.name: ease-standard
motion.purpose: Secondary easing for the cover-image zoom inside work cards.

breakpoints.name: tablet
breakpoints.purpose: Nav becomes fixed + hamburger; grid collapses to single column; hero margins compress to 32/64; type scale reduces

breakpoints.name: wide
breakpoints.purpose: Work grid collapses from 3-col to 2-col + stacked wide card

components.name: Work Card
components.description: Pure image card. No overlay, no scrim, no in-card label. Project identification lives in the marginalia caption above (separate component).
components.css: .ds-work-card { display: block; position: relative; border: 1px solid oklch(8% 0.008 40); border-radius: 6px; background: oklch(91% 0.007 75); overflow: hidden; text-decoration: none; color: inherit; aspect-ratio: 587 / 189; transition: transform 0.4s cubic-bezier(0.22, 1, 0.36, 1); } .ds-work-card:hover { transform: scale(1.015); } .ds-work-card:focus-visible { outline: 2px solid oklch(8% 0.008 40); outline-offset: 4px; } .ds-work-card__cover { width: 100%; height: 100%; object-fit: cover; display: block; transition: transform 0.35s ease; } .ds-work-card:hover .ds-work-card__cover { transform: scale(1.04); }

components.name: Marginalia Caption
components.description: Editorial signature: small uppercase kicker label that floats above each work card cell, naming the project. Replaces the in-card label overlay.
components.html: Marginalia
components.css: .ds-cell { display: flex; flex-direction: column; gap: 6px; } .ds-marginalia { font-family: Inter, system-ui, sans-serif; font-size: 10px; font-weight: 500; letter-spacing: 0.14em; text-transform: uppercase; color: oklch(42% 0.008 40); height: 12px; line-height: 12px; overflow: hidden; white-space: nowrap; text-overflow: ellipsis; } .ds-marginalia__inner { display: inline-block; } .ds-work-card-mini { display: block; border: 1px solid oklch(8% 0.008 40); border-radius: 6px; background: oklch(91% 0.007 75); overflow: hidden; aspect-ratio: 587 / 189; } .ds-work-card-mini img { width: 100%; height: 100%; object-fit: cover; display: block; }

components.name: Section Mark
components.description: Numbered chapter identifier at the top of every section. Same Label micro typography as marginalia.
components.css: .ds-section-mark { font-family: Inter, system-ui, sans-serif; font-size: 10px; font-weight: 500; letter-spacing: 0.12em; text-transform: uppercase; color: oklch(42% 0.008 40); margin-bottom: 16px; }

components.name: Nav Link
components.description: Minimal navigation anchor. Opacity fade on hover; 2px ink outline on focus-visible.
components.html: Work About Contact
components.css: .ds-nav { display: flex; gap: 32px; } .ds-nav-link { font-family: Inter, system-ui, sans-serif; font-size: 14px; font-weight: 500; color: oklch(8% 0.008 40); text-decoration: none; transition: opacity 0.2s; } .ds-nav-link:hover { opacity: 0.6; } .ds-nav-link:focus-visible { outline: 2px solid oklch(8% 0.008 40); outline-offset: 2px; }

components.name: Contact CTA
components.description: Inline text-with-icon CTA. Single ink underline (border-bottom), opacity fade on hover, arrow steps right, gap widens.
components.css: .ds-cta { display: inline-flex; align-items: center; gap: 10px; font-family: Inter, system-ui, sans-serif; font-size: 14px; font-weight: 500; color: oklch(8% 0.008 40); text-decoration: none; padding: 14px 0 4px; border-bottom: 1px solid oklch(8% 0.008 40); min-height: 44px; transition: opacity 0.25s cubic-bezier(0.22, 1, 0.36, 1), gap 0.25s cubic-bezier(0.22, 1, 0.36, 1); } .ds-cta:hover { opacity: 0.6; gap: 14px; } .ds-cta:focus-visible { outline: 2px solid oklch(8% 0.008 40); outline-offset: 4px; } .ds-cta__icon { display: block; width: 16px; height: 16px; } .ds-cta__label { letter-spacing: 0.01em; } .ds-cta__arrow { font-size: 14px; line-height: 1; transition: transform 0.25s cubic-bezier(0.22, 1, 0.36, 1); } .ds-cta:hover .ds-cta__arrow { transform: translate(2px, -2px); }

components.name: Footer
components.description: Border-top divider with credit text left and LinkedIn icon right. The icon link wrapper is 44×44 to satisfy mobile touch-target minimums.
components.css: .ds-footer { display: flex; align-items: center; justify-content: space-between; padding: 24px 120px; border-top: 1px solid oklch(8% 0.008 40); margin-top: 64px; } .ds-footer__credit { font-family: Inter, system-ui, sans-serif; font-size: 14px; font-weight: 500; color: oklch(8% 0.008 40); } .ds-footer__social { display: inline-flex; align-items: center; justify-content: center; min-width: 44px; min-height: 44px; color: oklch(8% 0.008 40); transition: opacity 0.2s; } .ds-footer__social:hover { opacity: 0.6; } .ds-footer__social:focus-visible { outline: 2px solid oklch(8% 0.008 40); outline-offset: 4px; } .ds-footer__icon { display: block; width: 20px; height: 20px; }

narrative.overview:
This portfolio thinks in spreads, not screens. The logic is borrowed from editorial print: generous white space, two typefaces held to strict roles, borders drawn in one color only. Aimee's work, full-color and conceptually dense across genres, needs a neutral to land against. The portfolio IS that neutral. It has no aesthetic agenda of its own; it creates the conditions for the work to be seen.

The personality is warm professional: rigorous enough to signal craft, restrained enough to stay out of the work's way. Nothing performs. The typewriter hero names the person. Everything after is curation.
keyCharacteristics: Two typefaces in absolute roles: Source Serif 4 carries identity, Inter carries function
Ink-only palette, two values plus one muted secondary, no accent and no gradient on type
8px card grid creates compression; 120px desktop margins create air; mobile collapses to 16px
Borders are the only structural signal: no shadow, no blur, no surface lifting
Motion is earned: the typewriter intro has permission, scroll reveals have a low bar, decoration has none

rules.name: The Editorial Monochrome Rule
rules.body: There is no accent color. Introducing any tint, even a muted one, breaks the neutrality that makes the work images read.

rules.name: The Warm-Tinted Neutral Rule
rules.body: No pure #000 or #fff in any UI surface. Every neutral carries a low-chroma warm hue (≤0.008 chroma, hue 40–80°).

rules.name: The OKLCH-First Rule
rules.body: Color tokens are authored in OKLCH and gated behind @supports. Hex fallbacks sit at the top of the cascade so legacy browsers degrade gracefully.

rules.name: The Color-Not-Opacity Rule
rules.body: Secondary emphasis is carried by the Ink Muted token, never by opacity: 0.55 on Ink. Opacity-as-mute compounds and fails AA below 16px.

rules.name: The Two-Layer Rule
rules.body: Source Serif 4 is identity. Inter is function. Don't apply the serif to nav, buttons, or anything transactional. Don't apply Inter to the hero name or capabilities headings.

rules.name: The Hierarchy Ratio Rule
rules.body: The name-to-subtitle ratio must remain ≥ 2.5:1 at any viewport. Preserve this when adjusting clamp values.

rules.name: The Uppercase Micro Rule
rules.body: text-transform: uppercase is permitted only at Label micro (10px section marks and marginalia). Prohibited above that size.

rules.name: The Flat-By-Default Rule
rules.body: Surfaces are flat at rest. The only response to interaction is scale (cards), opacity (links), or border emphasis (focus). No hover shadows.

dos: Do let work images be the dominant element on every screen. The UI is the frame; the work is the art.
Do use generous page margins (--page-padding: 120px desktop, 24px tablet, 16px mobile) as a first response to 'this feels crowded.'
Do use cubic-bezier(0.22, 1, 0.36, 1) (ease-out-expo) for all transitions involving movement.
Do follow focus-visible with outline: 2px solid var(--color-ink) on every interactive element — 2px offset on inline links, 4px on cards and CTAs.
Do carry secondary emphasis via the Ink Muted token (var(--color-ink-muted)), never opacity: 0.55 on Ink.
Do use Label micro (10px / uppercase / 0.08–0.14em tracking) only for section marks and marginalia kickers.
Do apply the CLS-safe sizer pattern (grid-stacked aria-hidden sizer + typed span) to any future text animation that mutates content over time.
Do ensure every interactive element on mobile is at least 44×44px.
donts: Don't introduce an accent color. The Editorial Monochrome rule stands.
Don't use gradient text (background-clip: text with any gradient). Prohibited regardless of context.
Don't use border-left or border-right greater than 1px as a colored stripe on any card, callout, or list item.
Don't add overlay scrims or in-card label gradients on work cards. Cards are pure image; metadata lives in the marginalia caption above.
Don't add animation that performs rather than communicates. If the motion would be better still, it should be still.
Don't replicate Behance or Dribbble aesthetics — shiny hover effects, drop shadows on every card, gradient overlays as style.
Don't use scrolljacking, parallax on text, or particle effects.
Don't mute text with opacity (the alpha compounds and fails AA). Use the Ink Muted color token.
Don't ship interactive elements smaller than 44×44px on mobile.
Don't use em dashes in any user-facing copy. Use commas, colons, semicolons, periods, or parentheses.
Don't add cards inside cards, or nest containers that already have padding.
Don't add a dark mode speculatively. A dark variant requires a full design pass, not a CSS variable swap.
